title: Hourly saved payload traffic for seven UTC dates
status: Source and behavior contract; actual qualification is recorded separately in the published milestone.

control.label: Graph resolution
control.lifetime: Retained until the view is destroyed; no configuration write.

data.dates: The seven selected UTC dates, oldest to newest; independent of the current clock.
data.hourly_order: First selected date at 00:00 through last selected date at 23:00, exactly 168 fixed buckets.
data.source: Each accepted saved day supplies its optional hourly counters directly; no re-read or division of a daily total.
data.units: Signed 64-bit byte counts, including negative corrections; never bytes/s.
data.unknown: A missing day, empty day, header-only day, or absent hour is a gap, not zero.
data.zero: An observed zero is a real point.
data.ownership: Bounded scalar copies do not retain mutable source aliases.
data.validation: An invalid requested seven-day range has no new frame; any mismatched supplied row or snapshot date produces a correctly labelled all-unknown frame.

rendering.connections: Only adjacent known buckets connect, including across UTC midnight; unknown hours break both traces.
rendering.isolated: An isolated known value has a visible marker.
rendering.signed_range: Y range includes zero and both payload directions. Coordinates remain finite across the full int64 domain; no signed integer subtraction or absolute-value overflow.
rendering.ticks: Sparse UTC date/hour labels at midnight and the final hour when space permits. Exact bucket identity remains available in tooltips and copied facts.
rendering.tooltip: Nearest bucket; literal plain-text UTC date and hour plus exact signed payload values or Unknown.
rendering.legend: Payload download and upload have distinct colors and line styles.
rendering.size: Existing bounded 180–260 logical pixel plot height; narrow views preserve all facts.

unchanged.daily_view: Existing Daily chart, date controls and hourly table remain unchanged.
unchanged.seven_day_table: Exactly seven rows and eight columns, including all six saved counters and state, for either chart resolution. No weekly sum.
unchanged.workers_accounting: No parser, adapter, worker, DTO, fixture or accounting change.
unchanged.default: Daily remains the default History tab and Daily totals remains the default seven-day resolution.

lifecycle.rendering_only: Changing resolution makes no read request or session/request/date mutation and does not notify or reset the unchanged table model.
lifecycle.pending_and_error: Pending, failed, missing-day and profile/date reset states clear known values in the selected resolution.
lifecycle.hidden: Hidden/minimized resolution changes retain accepted packets but defer chart facts, tooltips and table mutation until visible.
lifecycle.stale: Existing nonzero session/request/date admission is unchanged.
lifecycle.reentry: Nested mode changes or a newer result win; older work stops after a plot callback. Direct owner deletion is guarded.
lifecycle.render_delivery: A resolution selection invalidates older work immediately; its GUI rendering is delivered after the selection control finishes changing. No read is requested.

original_source_reference.difference: Original rolling History uses current-clock period queries, pixel merging and integer display scaling. This selectable fixed saved UTC projection adds no original graph/UI runtime parity.

equality_scope.limits: Retained corpus checks compare saved numeric totals only; no new presence/error/current-clock/live-writer/global-owner/UI equality is claimed.
